snippet.title: Fish & Hike - Official Trailer | Coming June 4th! (Cozy Shiba Adventure)
snippet.description:
Fish & Hike launches into Steam Early Access on June 4th! 📅🚀
👉 Wishlist now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4143100/Fish__Hike/

Pack your bags for the ultimate cozy vacation in the Valley of Eight Lakes! 🗺️🎣

Play as Dr. Shiberson, an adorable Shiba Inu cartographer with a big heart and endless curiosity. What started as a peaceful holiday quickly turns into a charming adventure. The locals need your help, and every new trail leads to magical secrets and forgotten ancient mysteries.
